I also tightened the model/algorithm boundary. [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/DirectedGraph.java:5) is now public and returns read-only neighbor views, while [KahnTopologicalSorter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/KahnTopologicalSorter.java:6) now owns indegree construction itself instead of pushing algorithm-specific work into the graph model. The sorter contract is explicit through [TopologicalSorter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalSorter.java:3).
